text:
nora: FYI I hit a weird context corruption running longform summarization with magnet-13b-q2_k+tokenizer-v2. Token remap seems to produce non-monotonic indices under interleaved prefill.
ash: ugh. repro script?
nora: simple: 3 clients, staggered prefill windows with small overlaps. gist: 
```
python tools/repro_prefill_race.py --model magnet-13b-q2_k --clients 3 --windows "6144,4096,2048" --overlap 256 --iters 50
```
ben: logs?
nora: snippet from runtime log: 
```
[2026-06-08T11:05:12Z] session=c3 PREFILL start base=4096 len=4096
[2026-06-08T11:05:16Z] session=c1 PREFILL done base=0 len=6144
[2026-06-08T11:05:16Z] session=c2 PREFILL done base=2048 len=4096
[2026-06-08T11:05:16Z] WARN kv_token_remap non-monotonic remapped_idx: 4100 -> 4097
[2026-06-08T11:05:16Z] ERROR rotary_phase_mismatch layer=5 delta=3
```
nora: single-client runs clean. Multi-client hit rate ~1/30.
ash: interesting that remapped_idx goes backward by 3 tokens. that matches the phase delta. maybe an atomicity bug in the remap table update.
ben: could be a race between prefix-evict and remap insert. when two streams finish, we assign slot indices and one path does a subtract when it should add.
dev-bot: @nora created job prefill-race-bisect-1809997777 on worker-canary-2 :white_check_mark:
nora: I tried forcing a global prefill lock (dev flag runtime::prefill_global_lock=true) and the failure vanished in 200 runs. So definitely a concurrency issue.
nash: good find. still need to be careful about perf impact. maybe make remap updates atomic without full lock.
ben: also test whether quantization magnifies it. run same script with q8_0 vs q2_k.
nora: did that: q8_0 > no failure, q2_k reproduces. so quantization amplifies the symptom.
nash: then plan: 1) add atomic compare-exchange for remap table writes 2) add assertion to detect non-monotonic remap and fall back to safe append 3) add a flaky test in CI that runs repro_prefill_race 500x on canary.
ben: I'll prototype the CAS remap patch and also add a lightweight per-layer rotary checksum to help bisect if quant still shows issues after remap fix.
dev-bot: @ben started job cas-remap-probe-1809997777 :white_check_mark:
nora: thanks. I'll attach the failing traces to the issue (staging:/traces/1809997777-prefill-race) and open a small PR with the failing test first.
nash: if remap fix isn't enough, we should consider a runtime fallback: if phase_delta >1 then recompute rotation in higher precision for affected layers. safer but perf costy.
ben: agreed. we'll try CAS first.
nora: tagging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime. will post updates here. :mag:
